chapters.label: The chase
chapters.text: Euro twenty twenty-four, France against Belgium. Speedy Jérémy Doku kept racing into the space behind France’s defence. Here is how Jules Koundé chased a run like that: sprint back, and tackle!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Doku is past him, but Koundé never stops. He sprints flat out, catches up, and comes alongside.

chapters.label: From the side
chapters.text: Now he slides in from the side, not from behind. His boot reaches the ball first, and it rolls out of play.

chapters.label: Never stop
chapters.text: Never stop chasing! Sprint back, get alongside the attacker, and tackle from the side, not from behind.
